revised_prompt: Create a detailed 16-bit pixel art illustration in a wide landscape composition (16:9). Crisp hard pixel edges, carefully placed visible square pixels, no smoothing or blurry gradients. Warm muted retro palette of teal, warm grey, navy, cream and orange accents, lustrous gold coins, vivid red envelope. A joyous jackpot celebration in a cozy freelancer's home studio: a delighted freelancer seated at a desk recoils joyfully as a spectacular fountain of gold coins and blank illustrated banknotes erupts from their open laptop like a slot-machine jackpot. The laptop remains recognizable as a laptop. On its video call screen, a friendly client is visibly bowing respectfully while extending an enormous bright red envelope toward the viewer; the screen contains only the client's image and no interface text or symbols. Confetti scatters throughout the room. A charming cat beside the desk catches tumbling gold coins with its front paws. Strong expressive silhouettes, readable action, playful visual storytelling, detailed desk and room props, rich pixel shading with a warm cream ambient light. Coins have simple blank faces and banknotes are decorative plain rectangles without any writing or numerals. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks anywhere, including laptop, screen, notes, envelope, coins, clothing, wall art and props. No purple neon. Full-bleed opaque background fills the entire image edge to edge, including every corner; warm cream and teal room backdrop, no transparency, no cutouts, no empty or black corner areas, no black borders, no vignette.
